entities.summary: Sergio Roberto Santos Rodrigues was a Brazilian Carioca architect and designer, widely acknowledged as the father of modern Brazilian furniture. Along with Joaquim Tenreiro and José Zanine Caldas, Rodrigues was a pioneer of Brazilian industrial design and played a key role in introducing it to international audiences.
